headline: Clean: the replacement order and both fraud disputes are fully determined by the script, the transaction data, and the provisional-credit rules.
solution_check: The replacement is the same as in task_036. For the disputes: give get_card_last_4_digits (cc_890389b165_silver gives 5320); both are unauthorized_fraudulent_charge, contacted_merchant false, full_refund, noticed today (11/14/2025), card_action cancel_and_reissue. Provisional credit is true for both under doc_015: the account opened 04/15/2024, the reason is fraud, $487.99 and $299.95 are within $25 to $5,000 (Mid Tier), and there is no prior dispute history. Even counting in-session filings, at most 1 prior dispute exists. The gold matches and replays cleanly.
prior_note: The prior review also rated this task clean.
notes: The customer does not know her credit_card_account_id. The agent has to supply it, through give_discoverable_user_tool arguments or in chat, so the customer can run get_card_last_4_digits; that is feasible. Gold omits partial_refund_amount, which defaults to None, the same as passing null. card_last_4_digits must be the string "5320".
